name: VITROX
recent: ViTrox 在 2026 财年第三季度交出上市以来最佳季度业绩，营收与净利大幅增长。同期多名董事及高管在公开市场减持股份，另有雇员购股权计划新股上市。
notable: 2026 财年第三季度营收达 RM485.1 million，净利 RM118.6 million，均为上市以来最佳季度表现。
公司披露 20 项新产品，来自 RM89 million 的研发投入， trailing 12 个月营收达 RM1 billion。
雇员购股权计划（SGS）发行 82,500 股新股，已于 2026 年 10 月 8 日上市。
risks: 多名董事及高级管理层在 2026 年 9 月至 10 月期间于公开市场减持股份。
新闻报导提及供应链瓶颈可能对增长构成限制。
earnings: 2026 财年第三季度营收为 RM485.1 million，环比增长 29.4%，同比增长 165.0%；净利为 RM118.6 million，环比增长 39.4%，同比增长 321.5%；净利率为 24.4%，高于上一季度的 22.7%。

recent_en: ViTrox posted its best quarterly results since listing in Q3 FY2026, with revenue and net profit rising sharply. Meanwhile, several directors and senior management disposed of shares in the open market, and new shares from the Employees Share Grant Scheme were listed.
notable_en: Q3 FY2026 revenue reached RM485.1 million and net profit RM118.6 million, the best quarterly performance since listing.
The company unveiled 20 new products from RM89 million in R&D investment, with trailing 12-month revenue reaching RM1 billion.
82,500 new shares under the Employees Share Grant Scheme (SGS) were issued and listed on 8 October 2026.
risks_en: Several directors and senior management disposed of shares in the open market between September and October 2026.
News reports cited supply chain bottlenecks that may constrain growth.
earnings_en: Q3 FY2026 revenue was RM485.1 million, up 29.4% QoQ and 165.0% YoY; net profit was RM118.6 million, up 39.4% QoQ and 321.5% YoY; net margin was 24.4%, up from 22.7% in the previous quarter.
